CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFMODULE

Custom tags are ordinary CFML templates that you call like tags. <CF_TITLEBOX> runs titlebox.cfm from the directory of the calling page or from the custom tags directory; CFMODULE does the same thing for a template you name explicitly, which avoids name clashes and lets you keep tags anywhere. Every other attribute of the call is passed to the tag.

Category

Extensibility

Syntax

<CFMODULE TEMPLATE="path"
    NAME="tag_name"
    ATTRIBUTECOLLECTION="structure"
    attribute_name="value" ...>
  [body]
[</CFMODULE>]

Attributes

TEMPLATE
Required if NAME is not given. Path of the custom tag template, relative to the calling page (or a mapping such as "/CFDOCS/snippets/sn_titlebox.cfm").
NAME
Required if TEMPLATE is not given. Name of a tag below the custom tags directory, with dots for subdirectories: NAME="allair.titlebox" runs customtags/allair/titlebox.cfm.
ATTRIBUTECOLLECTION
Optional. A structure whose keys and values are passed as attributes, in addition to any written out in the call.

Usage

Inside a custom tag, three scopes connect it with the outside world:

  • Attributes: the attributes of the call. Use CFPARAM to give them defaults.
  • Caller: the calling page's local variables. <CFSET Caller.Result = 42> hands a value back.
  • ThisTag: ThisTag.ExecutionMode ("start" or "end"), ThisTag.HasEndTag, ThisTag.GeneratedContent (the output of the body, which the end pass may change) and ThisTag.AssocAttribs (see CFASSOCIATE).

A tag called with an end tag (or with the XML-style <CF_TAG/>) runs twice: once in start mode, then the body runs in the caller's context, then the tag runs again in end mode. Without an end tag it runs once. The tag's own variables are private: they are not visible to the caller and vanish when the tag ends. CFEXIT leaves a tag early (METHOD="ExitTag", "ExitTemplate" or "Loop" to run the body again). GetBaseTagList and GetBaseTagData let nested tags find their ancestors.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- sn_titlebox.cfm is a custom tag in this directory --->
<CFSET BoxesDrawn = 0>

<CFMODULE TEMPLATE="sn_titlebox.cfm" TITLE="Called with CFMODULE" COLOR="##CCCCFF">
  The text between the start and end tags is the body.
</CFMODULE>

<CF_SN_TITLEBOX TITLE="Called as CF_SN_TITLEBOX" SHOUT="Yes">
  The end pass of this tag turned the body into capitals.
</CF_SN_TITLEBOX>

<CF_SN_TITLEBOX TITLE="Called without an end tag">

<CFOUTPUT><P>The tag counted its boxes in Caller.BoxesDrawn: #BoxesDrawn#</P></CFOUTPUT>
